 Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Vinod S. Bhardwaj

Present :- Mr. Manglesh Kumar, Advocate for
 Mr. Shakti Mehta, Advocate for the petitioner
 petitioner.

The instant petition has been filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 for grant of anticipatory bail to the petitioner in case bearing Fir No.0164 dated 17.10.2025
registered under Sections 406, 6, 420, 506 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at Police Station City
Samana,, District Patiala.

2.  Learned counsel for the petitioner inter alia contends that pursuant to the order dated 04.12.2025 passed by this Court, the petitioner has joined investigation and is no longer required for investigation of the case.
3.
Learned State counsel on instructions, corroborates the said averment and submits that the custodial interrogation of the petitioner is not required for the purpose of investigation.

4. Heard learned learned counsel for the parties.
5.

Since the petitioner has joined the investigation and her custodial interrogation is not required,
the present petition is allowed and the interim order dated 04.12.2025 is made absolute.

6. However, if required, the petitioner(s) petitioner(s) shall continue to join investigation as and when required to do so and shall abide by the terms and conditions, as laid down under Section 482 (2) BNSS.
